segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin called it a game changer for fading dark spots, and another cross-mentions dry patches appearing as a side effect during a breakout episode.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, stinging, or redness even after laser hair removal or with eczema-prone skin, while others describe swelling, itchy rash, or bumps around the eyes and advise patch testing first.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe the serum as lightweight and non-oily, with one noting it provided hydration without breakouts and another crediting it for clearer, brighter skin.
segments.mature: A 63-year-old reviewer with melasma reports the serum, used alongside retinal and niacinamide, visibly faded a stubborn dark spot and brightened her skin.

concerns.aging: A mature reviewer using it alongside retinal, niacinamide and sunscreen reports a stubborn age-related dark spot visibly fading and brighter skin overall.
concerns.dehydration: Not enough reviewers describe dryness as their primary concern to draw a pattern; one review mentions dry patches appearing as a side effect during a bad reaction.
concerns.redness: Reports are mixed: some say redness decreased alongside fading discoloration, one reviewer with post-erythema redness from hormonal acne saw no change and increased breakouts, and another describes new redness and dry patches emerging after initial improvement.
concerns.barrier: A small number describe adverse reactions consistent with barrier upset — swelling, itchy rash, and tiny clear bumps around the eyes — with two advising caution or a dermatologist visit; most other reviewers report no such issues.
concerns.spots: The large majority report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, or acne marks, often within one to eight weeks with consistent use; however, several reviewers used a full bottle for weeks to months with no visible change to their dark spots at all.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts and clearer skin over time (including on the body/back), but others report new breakouts, cystic pimples, or worsening blemishes after initial improvement, particularly among acne-prone or sensitive users.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers note the serum does not leave skin greasy or oily and layers easily under moisturizer; no reports describe it increasing oiliness.

extraits.texte: I was really looking forward to trying this serum, but after almost finishing a bottle of it, I have noticed no changes at all to my dark spots. I struggle with discoloration from acne, and there was literally no change at all to any scars. I love this brand and its affordability, but if you struggle badly with dark discoloratio,n i would not purchase this

Noticed an immediate fading on my dark spots left from cystic acne within two days!! THEN the little breaks outs… the dry skin patches… the redness… if you have sensetive skin or acne prone this is NOT the product for you!!

extraits.titre: did nothing and broke me out
extraits.texte: i wanted this to work so bad. it didn't. i have post erythema redness from years of hormonal acne and this serum made zero difference. no fading, no calming, nothing. on top of that, it actually broke me out, which made the discoloration worse. i get that skincare is personal and what works for one person might not work for another, but for me this performed worse than other serums at the same price point. i know nothing will erase redness completely, but this didn't even move the needle. it's fairly priced if it works for you. it just didn't for me, so i won't be buying it again.

I love this serum, it is so underrated it worked so well for my skin and I saw results after just a few weeks! I have struggled with hormonal acne for years which comes and goes, and this reduced my acne scars so quick. For refrence, I have combination, acne-prone, sensitive skin. This product did not make my skin oily it just provided some nice hydration. Although, i'm not completely sure if it breaks me out or not since i've always had acne. But i'm almost sure it doesn't because I don't see new break outs when I use it. I have been using this for almost 2 months and I keep on seeing results.

I am 63 years old with pretty good skin with the exception of melasma, mainly a small dark spot. I was using G.M. retinal's, niacinamide and sunscreen. and they kept my skin soft, firm & protected but the spot would not vanish. with the G.M Toner and the discoloration correcting serum the spot is visibly fading, and it is brightening my skin. I like the results this serum provides.

I have sensitive, combination/normal skin with PIH and melasma. It is wild how effectively and quickly this stuff is erasing my dark post-acne spots; I have been using this every morning and every other night, and the lighter dark spots were gone within 2 weeks and after a month of use my darkest & most stubborn spots are faded to the point where only I can tell they're still there. I've also noticed that blemishes I've had since starting this product barely leave a mark to begin with. My melasma patches are also a bit lighter, but it's less noticeable/dramatic than I've seen with the PIH. Will be interested to see if it continues to budge as time passes. Either way I cannot recommend enough trying this stuff out if you have stubborn dark PIH spots.

This serum + body treatment lotion = better results; I use both on my body not on my face. The results are slowly but surely. I have sensitive skin, I use it after having laser hair removal and it does NOT irritate my skin. I love it!
